scenes.spoken_text: A material family is not a complete specification. Identify its structure, then compare the actual products and supporting data before selecting construction details.
scenes.caption: A material family is not a complete specification. Identify its structure, then compare the actual products and supporting data before selecting construction details.

scenes.spoken_text: Inspect an identified cross-section. Distinguish solid wood and its grain from plywood veneer layers and an MDF fibre-based panel. A facing can hide the core, so specify core and face separately. A wood appearance does not establish that the entire board is solid timber.
scenes.caption: The cross-section separates core from facing.

scenes.display_title: Request data for the actual product
scenes.spoken_text: Record the product code, thickness, sheet size, grade and declared use. Request data relevant to the environment and proposed fixing system. Do not infer water resistance or joint capacity from a family name alone; different grades and constructions require review of the actual product data.
scenes.caption: Connect performance claims to an identified product and grade.

scenes.display_title: Relate the material to the whole construction
scenes.spoken_text: Compare alternatives for the same part and use. Review core, thickness, facing, edges, joints and finish as a system, and record missing data. If the product changes after drawing issue, recheck details, schedules and samples. The same colour does not establish the same construction requirements.
scenes.caption: Product substitution triggers a review of details and schedules.

scenes.spoken_text: Two veneered boards look alike but have different cores and grades. The brief is a cabinet in a dry interior; hinge and fixing compatibility are still unconfirmed. Decision: compare product data and joint details before accepting a substitute based on appearance.
scenes.caption: Decision: compare product data and joint details before accepting a substitute based on appearance.

scenes.display_title: Compare two identified products and list the data still needed before selection.
scenes.spoken_text: Compare two identified products and list the data still needed before selection.
scenes.caption: Compare two identified products and list the data still needed before selection.
